verdict.rationale: Alloy is a fraud and identity decisioning platform, so measuring detection quality against labelled cases is a fair question for it. The pack documents workflows, event monitoring, ML-based Fraud Signal and alerting. It has no evidence of backtesting, labelled validation datasets, or metrics for detection rates or incorrect clearances (false negatives).

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can measure detection quality and incorrect clearances against labelled validation cases
